g.text: One-batch-ahead PPO with explicit behavior correction
TIS weight = clamp(exp(trainer-before-update logprob − behavior logprob), 0, 2)
Native reducer over valid action tokens; PPO clipping is separate. Means can hide tails, so upper-clipped fraction is shown too.
Recorded rollout lag is an instrumentation field; generation response versions and TIS mismatch provide independent runtime evidence.
